Total marks 100

Number of questions 50
Marks per correct answer 2
Negative marking No marks will be deducted for wrong answers
Subjects General knowledge, arithmetic, Marathi language, geographical and historical information of Ratnagiri district, etc.
Exam date 15 November 2026, at the centre and time printed on the admit card

Selection is based on a written examination. The notification does not mention an interview or physical test. Selected candidates must still submit certificates and complete document verification before appointment.
The exam pattern follows the Revenue and Forest Department Government Resolution dated 17/05/2023
as cited in the notification. Any candidate who commits or attempts any improper or illegal act during the exam will be disqualified immediately.
After the exam

the answer key will be displayed on the notice boards of the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri and the Sub-Divisional Officer Office Ratnagiri. The notification states that this answer key is final and no objections will be accepted. The written exam result
along with the list of seat numbers

will be displayed on the same notice boards. The merit order depends on marks obtained out of 100 in the written exam. A category-wise selection list and a waiting list will be prepared based on the marks obtained. In case of a tie in qualifying marks or merit
action will be taken as per the prevailing Government resolutions and rules. If a selected candidate does not join within 15 days of the appointment order

the next candidate on the waiting list will be appointed. No complaint on this will be entertained. The appointment order will be given to eligible candidates on the final selection list only after verification of the original documents.
Within 1 month of selection
finally selected candidates must submit a "character and conduct" certificate from the competent authority. Within 1 month of selection
they must also submit a medical certificate of physical fitness from the District Surgeon
Ratnagiri. After appointment

the Mahsul Sevak must take the prescribed oath of loyalty to the Constitution of India. Candidates must live in the saja to which they are appointed and submit an undertaking to that effect. Otherwise the appointment will be cancelled. At the time of joining
the candidate must submit a personal compensation bond as per Rule 51 of the Bombay Financial Rules
1959. The Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) is a full-time servant
and the appointment is on a temporary basis.
how_to_apply: The notification describes an offline process. Follow these steps.
Collect the prescribed application form from the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office. The form costs Rs. 50/- in cash, and a receipt is given.
Fill in the form completely and clearly, mentioning the reservation category (if applying from a reserved category).
Paste a self-attested recent colour photograph in the space provided, and attach two more colour photographs.
Attach the small family certificate and self-attested or attested copies of all required documents.
Put the application and documents in a sealed envelope and write your full name on the envelope.

Submit the application in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office, with the Rs. 500/- examination fee in cash, between 02 October 2026 and 17 October 2026 during office hours, excluding government holidays.
Collect the admit card between 08 November 2026 and 10 November 2026 from the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri after showing an identity proof.

There is no online application for this recruitment. Only applications received in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office will be considered. Applications sent by email or post, or submitted by any other method, will not be considered. Application forms photocopied or printed from another source will be rejected at scrutiny. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.
According to the notification, the following applications will not be considered:
Applications not in the prescribed format.
Applications where the prescribed fee has not been paid.
Applications from candidates who do not meet the educational, residence or category conditions.
Applications without all required documents attached with attestation.
Applications without a photograph or without self-attestation.
Applications received after the deadline or not received through the prescribed method.
Applications with a recommendation from any political party, organization or person attached.
important_instructions: Reservation applies as per the category-wise posts listed above. The notification sets these conditions for candidates applying from reserved categories.

A candidate claiming a reserved post must attach attested copies of the caste/category certificate issued by the competent authority and, where applicable, the non-creamy layer certificate. Backward-class candidates must produce the original caste certificate and original caste validity certificate at the time of verification. If a selected backward-class candidate cannot produce the caste validity certificate, a temporary appointment may be given after the candidate submits a bond or affidavit promising to submit it within six months. The notification cites the General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 12/12/2011 for this. If the certificate is not submitted within the prescribed period of at most six months after appointment, the service will be terminated. Backward-class candidates other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes must attach an attested copy of a valid non-creamy layer certificate showing that they are not in the creamy layer. EWS candidates must attach an attested copy of a valid EWS certificate, issued as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolutions dated 12/02/2019 and 31/05/2021. SEBC candidates must attach attested copies of the caste certificate and the non-creamy layer certificate, as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 29 January 2025 (or the equivalent resolution in force at the time). Creamy layer candidates from other backward classes will not get the reservation of that class. The reserved category must be clearly mentioned in the application. Otherwise the application will be rejected. The application will be considered only under the category for which the candidate has applied, and no complaint on this point will be entertained later. Women candidates must submit the application in their maiden name (name by birth), in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required to Apply
content_sections.text: Attach self-attested or attested copies of all documents with the application. Original documents must be produced at verification, otherwise the candidate will be disqualified. Class 4 pass marksheet, or a certificate showing the highest educational qualification obtained. School leaving certificate, bonafide certificate or secondary school examination certificate stating the date of birth, or a birth certificate. Residence certificate from the Tahsildar showing that the candidate is a resident of a village in Ratnagiri District. Maharashtra domicile certificate (Age, Nationality and Domicile Certificate). Self-attested copy of any one identity proof: Aadhaar card, voter ID or PAN card. Caste certificate and caste validity certificate (if applicable) for reserved posts; a valid non-creamy layer certificate for other backward classes; a valid EWS certificate for EWS candidates (if applicable). Small family certificate in the prescribed format. A sample is provided with the application form. Unmarried candidates must clearly write "unmarried" on it. Without this certificate the application is liable to be rejected. One recent colour photograph, self-attested and firmly pasted at the prescribed place on the application, plus two additional colour photographs. Attested copy of the relevant Government Gazette if the candidate's name has changed after passing Class 4.
